description: Register a new visitor named 'Elena Rosales' from 'Apex Structural' for a long-term project. Set her visitor record expiration date to be exactly 14 days from today (e.g., if today is Jan 1st, set it to Jan 14th). After creating the record, you must generate proof of the expiration setting: either take a screenshot of the Visitor Properties/Badge window showing the expiration date, or export the record to a file. Save this proof to '~/Documents/multiday_pass_proof.png' (if screenshot) or '~/Documents/multiday_pass_info.txt' (if export).
